overview: When a woman is found murdered with scent glands excised from her body, a detective probes a group of friends who attended boarding school with her.
title: Parfum

overview: An anthology of four short films, inspired by the Black Mirror series.
title: Czarne lusterko

overview: Set during the Xia dynasty, the first ever recorded dynasty in Chinese history. It is a period rife with influences of mythology and folklore since it's close to the beginning of time when Pangu was said to have opened the heaven and the earth.
title: The Legend of Jade Sword

overview: Ru Xiao Lan is a young woman from the modern day. Through a series of circumstances, she travels to the ancient times as a cat. Purely by chance, she meets Qing Mo Yan who's suffering from a poison and as they kiss, they realize that they've found the solution to each other's complications. Deciding to stick together for their own gain, the two embark on a journey to find the five-colored stone that can break Xiao Lan's curse and the ghost grass that can cure Mo Yan's affliction.
title: I'm a Pet at Dali Temple

overview: Former military officer Li Zhicheng returns to the corporate world to save his family's from bankruptcy, where he meets brainy and enthusiastic Lin Qian
title: Our Glamorous Time

overview: Jack Whitehall hosts a comedy chat show with a twist: he's joined by his dad.
title: Backchat with Jack Whitehall and His Dad

overview: Esther Rantzen takes on unscrupulous traders who target older people.
title: Esther Rantzen's House Trap

overview: Documentary series set on the Owen family's remote farm in the Yorkshire Dales.
title: Our Yorkshire Farm

overview: The series of documentary programs "This is a real story" will tell about high-profile crimes committed in Russia since the early 2000s. Behind each trial is a social drama: poverty, phobias, loneliness or mental illness that no one noticed.
title: Это реальная история

overview: Coffee, Please revolves around Lee Seul Bi, a chubby girl, who becomes beautiful after drinking magical coffee, and a handsome webtoon artist who doesn't believe in love until he meets Lee Seul Bi.
title: Coffee, Please

overview: The Stars Aligned project is a meeting place for representatives of pop music, cinema, art and other creative professions. The discussion of the star-studded NTV project can center on anything except politics. What the whole country talks about in the kitchen, argues about on the forum or gossips on a bench near the house - from a new photo shoot of a famous ballerina to the unexpected birth of children from a surrogate mother of another artist, from a scandal on the Internet to the wedding or divorce of a celebrity. Famous people and experts, together with the hosts, will turn the studio into a platform for publicity, a tribune for exchanging opinions, because "Stars Aligned" so that they can finally be heard! They will thoroughly understand the situation, convey alternative points of view to viewers with the help of scientific data, reports, interviews with participants and witnesses of events, as well as the opinions of authoritative experts.
title: Звёзды сошлись
Volt egyszer egy Vadkelet – Emir Kusturicával

overview: A prankster prince who wants to experience life as an ordinary teen leaves his kingdom to live incognito with a single mom and her studious son.
title: Prince of Peoria

overview: Talk & interview show, mostly on socio-cultural issues, hosted by Alexey Pivovarov and Tikhon Dzyadko.
title: На троих

overview: This brand new show for ITV4 pits two celebrities against each other in a battle to become top fisherman.
title: The Big Fish Off

overview: Border Live crews will be embedded out in the field with officers and special agents at key border sites from Nogales, Ariz., in the west to the Rio Grande Valley and points east. Discovery will also be on-the-ground with law enforcement offices in Texas including the City of San Juan Police Department and Cameron County Sheriff's Office as well as in Arizona with the Cochise County Sheriff's Office. The timely series, announced earlier this month, will document the work of law enforcement on the U.S.-Mexico border as well as the real lives, real moments and real stories of those that live and work along its remote stretches.
title: Border Live

overview: Hanzai Shokogun Season 1 and Season 2 follows Takashi Muto (and Mamoru Kabugari (Shosuke Tanihara) who lost the same person. She is the younger sister of Takashi Muto and the girlfriend of Mamoru Kabugari. "Season 1" focuses on Takashi Muto's story and "Season 2" focuses on Mamoru Kabugari. Takashi Muto is a detective full of justice. When he was young, he lost his parents. He still has his younger sister whom he cares for a lot, but she is murdered. The killer is a minor and he is able to avoid punishment. Takashi decides to take revenge on him, but the murderer kills himself. Takashi quits his job as a detective. One year later, he takes on a special mission which the investigation division of the Tokyo Metropolitan Police Department can not perform.
title: Criminal Syndrome

overview: A school principal joins forces with musical experts and a singing superstar on a mission, to transform the lives of disadvantaged Aussie kids through the power of music.
title: Don't Stop the Music

overview: Documentary series going behind the scenes at London's Corinthia hotel, following staff as they navigate the challenges of running a world-class hotel.
title: A Hotel for the Super Rich & Famous

overview: What is more important while traveling - famous museums and unique monuments or hot sun and new acquaintances? The eternal struggle between the craving for knowledge and the thirst for sensual pleasures will be embodied in the new show of the TV-3 channel and Comedy Club Production "Knowledge and Emotions".
title: Знания и эмоции

overview: 200 babies are brought together to take part in an ambitious scientific study exploring how the incredible changes that happen in the first two years of life make us who we are.
title: Babies: Their Wonderful World

overview: A look behind the scenes at Cliveden House, one of the country's most exclusive country house hotels.
title: A Very British Country House

overview: Cuckoo is every parent's worst nightmare - a slacker full of outlandish, New Age ideas.
title: Cuckoo

overview: Molly spends her summer with her big brother Mack on his toy stall. They share adventures together in the market with the warm, funny, loving community who work there.
title: Molly and Mack

overview: The story of Runway, a high school boy who falls in love with Dream, a mysterious man he meets every night in his dreams. He also starts having confused feelings for his close friend Guide and for his neighbor Tanai, a freshman in the faculty of engineering.
title: My Dream The Series

overview: Warship: Life at Sea documents the everyday life on board HMS Duncan, one of the most advanced warships in the world. With unprecedented access to the Royal Navy's £1billion Type 45 Destroyer over a seven month-period, cameras capture the most dramatic moments in the ship's short history. The series follows the ups and downs of Duncan's crew and reveals their lives on the ship in intimate detail, as these 280 men and women, including their female captain, find themselves at the centre of some of the most sensitive military operations in recent years.
title: Warship: Life at Sea

overview: Will Millard discovers Wales's hidden history by exploring forgotten, secret and almost inaccessible locations that show the country as it has never been seen before.
title: Hidden Wales with Will Millard

overview: The invention of trains transformed everything about how humans lived. From the movement of goods and population, the design of cities, to conquest and warfare, there are few aspects of civilization that were left untouched by these machines.
title: How Trains Changed the World

overview: A comedy series about the Hedlund's starting a new life in the far north of Sweden. The father Petter, runs in to culture clashes while Madde has an identity crisis; is she still the small-town girl from northern Sweden or did the big city change her more than she'd like to admit?
title: Andra åket

overview: The iron-fisted Akhandanand Tripathi is a millionaire carpet exporter and the mafia don of Mirzapur. His son, Munna, is an unworthy heir who will stop at nothing to inherit his father's legacy. An incident at a wedding forces him to cross paths with Ramakant Pandit, an upstanding lawyer, and his sons, Guddu and Bablu. It snowballs into a game of ambition, power and greed in this lawless city.
title: Mirzapur

overview: When Alex Irving, a charismatic and contradictory Indigenous woman, is thrust into the national limelight after a horrific event, Australia's embattled Prime Minister Rachel Anderson, sees a publicity goldmine for her party. In a bold power play, she handpicks Alex for the Senate. But Alex wants to be more than just a political stunt: she wants to make a difference. So, when the Prime Minister's cynical calculations betray her, Alex sets out for revenge that will send the political establishment into meltdown.
title: Total Control

overview: Dynamo: Magician Impossible is a fly on the wall documentary series which follows the life of English magician Steven Frayne, better known as Dynamo. The show is produced by Phil McIntyre Productions and Inner Circle Films for UKTV channel Watch and Universal Networks International. In 2012, the show was shortlisted at the 17th National Television Awards for Best Entertainment Program but lost to Michael McIntyre's Comedy Roadshow.
title: Dynamo: Magician Impossible

overview: Welcome to Arcadia Heights. Whether its the high-rise or the high life where we live doesnt define who we are. We follow six families, navigating the challenges of everyday life in an ever-changing urban community.
title: The Heights

overview: Meet seven young people who choose their own path. Despite being in the starting pit, they know very well what they want, and they do everything to achieve the dream. They have high expectations, both for themselves and their surroundings. This series takes young people's everyday life seriously, and reflects life as a teenager in one of the world's richest countries in 2018.
title: Generasjon Z

overview: Based on the popular blog and bestselling e-book by Ben Phillips, the show is a series of love letters to the hearts and minds of those who make a city pulse. The series follows Uber driver Ben as he tries to figure out what he should be doing while helping others get where they're going. Against the ticking clock of impending fatherhood, Ben must decipher what being 'relevant' looks like in a relationship that seems to think he's surplus to requirements.
title: Diary of an Uber Driver

overview: Marcus Lemonis looks back at classic episodes of The Profit, discussing lessons learned and revealing behind-the-scenes stories with Executive Producer Amber Mazzola.
title: The Profit: An Inside Look

overview: It's a mistake to think that Seoul is a place for buildings, forests, and a busy lifestyle! NCT leads the way in search for finding Seoul's colorful charms. What are some charms that NCT has found? Let's embark on a journey filled with passion and romance (or dreams?) with NCT!
title: Hot&Young Seoul Trip

overview: In Sahara, Bram Vermeulen crosses the largest sand desert on earth
title: Sahara

overview: The man of mystery returns. But he's put down his phone and now he's up close and personal!
title: Facejacker

overview: Erling returns to Oslo after dropping out of school and skipping town eight months ago.
title: Semester

overview: The season of baking is upon us, and Food Network has upped the gingerbread ante with an over-the-top seasonal showdown unlike any other. Watch as passionate holiday bakers face off for the chance to earn $25,000 in the grand finale with host Marcela at the helm.
title: Holiday Gingerbread Showdown

overview: The first-ever spoiled, unjust, and overly cunning unconventional hero in drama history just might have been borne! Heroic main character Mitsuhashi, who sports a perm and blond hair, goes by the credo, "I will win no matter what it takes!" Yet for a main character, he is rather unjust, conniving, and calculating! Perhaps these descriptions make him seem like a despicable person, but it is actually quite satisfying and refreshing to see this sharp-thinking fellow beat the heck out of every single bad guy that appears.
title: From Today, It's My Turn!!

overview: A five-episode continuation anthology of the stories of Arthit and Kongpob, Kao and Pete, Mork and Tee, Rome and Pick, and Sun and In.
title: Our Skyy

overview: Tony Robinson takes an exciting tomb-hunting adventure across Egypt to investigate the startling series of recent tomb discoveries that are revealing new facts about life in the ancient world.
title: Egyptian Tomb Hunting

overview: Documentary series following the army of workers who keep one of London's busiest shopping streets moving.
title: Oxford Street 24/7

overview: Documentary series going behind the scenes of a plus-size modelling agency.
title: Curvy Girls Stripped Bare

overview: A new weekly talk show is coming to Lifetime, hosted by the renowned stylist and designer, Rachel Zoe. Straight from Zoe's fashion empire headquarters on Melrose Avenue, "Fashionably Late with Rachel Zoe" gives viewers the definitive inside look into what's hot and what's not in fashion, beauty and pop culture. Joined by fashion insider and Harper's Bazaar Editor-At-Large Derek Blasberg, Zoe's husband Rodger Berman, and their celebrity friends, each episode will be a fun, glamour-packed look at the world around us through the lens of fashion. The half-hour talker premieres Thursday, September 24, at 10:30pm ET/PT, following all-new episodes of "Project Runway." "Fashionably Late with Rachel Zoe" is produced by Hudsun Media with Michael Rourke, Kay O'Connell, Rachel Zoe and Rodger Berman serving as executive producers. Eli Lehrer, Mary Donahue and David Hillman of Lifetime also executive produce. A total of eight episodes have been ordered for this season, adding to Lifetime's roster of fashion-centric programming that includes Emmy nominated "Project Runway," "Project Runway All Stars" and upcoming new series, "Project Runway Junior."
title: Fashionably Late with Rachel Zoe

overview: Irina Shikhman takes interviews with the most unexpected guests: musicians, actors, writers, politicians and public figures.
title: А поговорить?

overview: Cowboy Bebop is about three bounty hunters, aka "cowboys," all trying to outrun the past. As different as they are deadly, Spike Spiegel, Jet Black, and Faye Valentine form a scrappy, snarky crew ready to hunt down the solar system's most dangerous criminals — for the right price. But they can only kick and quip their way out of so many scuffles before their pasts finally catch up with them.
title: Cowboy Bebop

overview: Within the walls of an interrogation room and with time running out, London investigators go after three suspects, each accused of a grievous crime.
title: Criminal: UK

overview: Archaeologist Ben Robinson explores the story of the village from Norman times to the present day.
title: Pubs, Ponds and Power: The Story of the Village

overview: How many secrets one true love can endure? How many obstacles? All the secrets and lies the characters have to go through in this story of crime and passion will kept them apart from their loved ones. They will do anything - just for love.
title: Solo per amore

overview: Legal V is a Japanese scripted drama about a small legal firm that goes up against a large legal firm. The main character is Shoko Takanashi (Ryoko Yonekura) who is a former lawyer and rail maniac. She persuades a university professor, who is accredited as a lawyer but without practical experience, to open a law firm with her. Shoko Takanashi hires a lawyer and assistants to work at the new law firm. She also arranges to rent office space to be the base for the legal team and her abode by virtue of becoming its caretaker.
title: Legal V

overview: Hasegawa Takashi is a music composer who is going through bad times and doesn't believe in love. Murakami Amane is a bank employee and she always get scolded by her boss. They barely know each other, even though they work in the same building. One day, Takashi accidently e-mailed his works to Amane and they eventually get to know each other through the Internet, without revealing their true identities.
title: With Love

overview: The iconic Jerry Springer will slide from the stage to behind the bench using law and order to settle disputeson his new show. "Judge Jerry" will take on actual cases from real people. In each episode, Judge Springer will hear cases and render a verdict with a fair yet firm hand and always leave litigants with a dose of classic Springer wisdom.
title: Judge Jerry

overview: The Client List is about Texas housewife; Riley Parks, who, after being deserted by her husband, is left in serious financial straits and takes a job at a seemingly traditional day spa in a neighboring town. But when she realizes some of her co-workers also provide other services, Riley must make the difficult decision whether or not to embrace an opportunity for her to resolve her financial hardships. The series will follow Riley as she delicately balances a moral conflict between two starkly different lives -- one as a single mother in a conservative town struggling to provide for her family and the other as a savvy and ambitious businesswoman working with a raucous, sexy and unpredictable group of women. As Riley becomes more involved, she struggles while working in secrecy knowing her family and friends would disapprove of her decision.
title: The Client List

overview: Rob Dyrdek has spent most of his life turning fantasy into reality. Even as a young skateboarder, Rob defied all odds by going pro at the age of 16. Since then, Rob has always believed that even the wildest fantasies are possible if you commit to making them real. Fans of MTV's Rob and Big know that he proves it by embracing, pursuing and achieving the products of his own imagination.
title: Rob Dyrdek's Fantasy Factory

overview: Victorine Vingerhoets is in charge of her funeral home after the dead of her husband. With the help of her nephew Willie she tries to keep the company afloat.
title: RIP

overview: Nao Kitazawa, 34, leads a busy but fulfilling life as a doctor at a women's clinic and as fiancee to an elite psychiatric physician, Yuchi Ihara. With their wedding day a month off, Nao is preparing to move into a new home when she meets Shinji Mamiya, a struggling writer who works part-time as a mover and falls inexorably in love with him. The fateful encounter compels Nao to follow her heart and experience true love. Overwhelmed by Nao's passion, Shinji soon falls for her as well, but their budding romance is threatened by the tragic discovery that Nao has early onset Alzheimer's. What unfolds is a story of pure love. As Nao's symptoms worsen, Shinji spends the next ten years giving Nao mental and health support even as she begins to lose the precious memories they both shared.
title: Don't Forget Me

overview: In a bold and original new story set in contemporary Sweden, Young Wallander sees Henning Mankell's iconic detective Kurt Wallander investigate his gripping first case. The story focuses on the formative experiences – professional and personal - faced by Kurt as a recently graduated police officer in his early twenties.
title: Young Wallander

overview: After five years of trying, correspondent Thomas Erdbrink and director Roel van Broekhoven finally received permission from the authorities in Iran to film the VPRO series Onze man in Teheran. Through the eyes of Erdbrink you see an Iran which is rarely discussed in the news. A country where nothing is allowed, but everything is possible.
title: Onze man in Teheran

overview: Seventeen years after being wrongly imprisoned, a talented songwriter seeks justice agains the men who caused her downfall and killed her family.
title: La reina del flow

overview: When Jeff Ross and Dave Attell take the stage, no one is safe. With the help of special guests, they're packing a lot of laughs into one epic weekend.
title: Bumping Mics with Jeff Ross & Dave Attell

overview: Sitcom spin-off from Only Fools and Horses, featuring the characters of Boycie and Marlene adapting to life in rural Shropshire. Starring John Challis and Sue Holderness.
title: The Green Green Grass

overview: Nick Thorne is a businessman who has achieved success by marketing games. He finds himself drawn into a "reality game" by his former business partner Magnus, whom Nick had forced out of their games company after its initial success. Called "The One Game", this sees Nick take on a series of challenges which force him to explore his past, while both his professional and personal life come under threat.
title: The One Game

overview: Detectives: My Killer Case follows detectives as they reflect on some of their most memorable cases. From identifying one of Britain's most notorious female psychopath serial killers through to the Suffolk Strangler, the series takes viewers on a journey of discovery through police footage and expert evidence.
title: Detectives: My Killer Case

overview: This is My Song invites ordinary people to work with the music industry's most talented producers to create a track for a very personal reason.
title: This is My Song

overview: Sun Ah, Tae Woo, Kwak Woong, and Do Woo are workers at a company. Sun Ah and Tae Woo struggle keeping their office romance a secret. Do Woo has a one-sided crush on Kwak Woong and hopes to confess her feelings to him. When Sun Ah and Tae Woo's relationship is revealed and Do Woo decides to take action on her feelings, they come to realize that office romances are not so easy.
title: Wish Woosh

overview: When her father dies under obscure circumstances, Patsa decides to abort her study and return home to Thailand. While trying to solve the mystery of her father's death, she starts to build feelings for Taywat, who is an adoptive son of her father and works as lawyer.
title: Khun Noo Ruen Lek

overview: With bright hopes for the future, Lee Yan Long's dreams came to a halt when his wife Jill got kidnapped around Christmas and travels back in time to find clues about her disappearance. He soon discovers that the suspect may be one of his old roommates from college.
title: Wife Interrupted

overview: Young heroes of the serial, teenagers, are experiencing many exciting and dangerous adventures, actively participating in the events of the civil war…
title: Макар-следопыт

overview: Timur's dad stars in this action packed film where he tries to capture a snake...in a classroom. The tension is tense and the action is action-filled. Timur makes a guest appearance as a sperm in his father's testes.
title: Завещание старого мастера

overview: A woman with early onset Alzheimer's Disease goes missing. Is she wandering around in an Alzheimer's haze or did something go very wrong with her husband's drug dealing business.
title: Mrs. Fitzgerald Is Missing

overview: Heartbreak High is a hip and realistic series about the lives of teenage students, their families and teachers at a high school. Heartbreak High is set in an inner city school at Sydney Beach, Hartley High, within a multi-racial area. Heartbreak High was originally a stage play which producer, Ben Gannon, turned into a successful film The Heartbreak Kid in 1993. The show captured more than 70 per cent of the youth audience in its first five weeks of broadcast in Australia.
title: Heartbreak High

overview: Can a magical letter in a bottle help someone face the most difficult issues in their lives? Emily is an assistant in a law firm that specializes in divorce cases. Although she has the help of her best friend photographer, Dou Ru, life hasn't been easy. Her boyfriend treats her more like a servant than a lover, she hasn't talked to her father in years, and she is bullied at work. One day she finds a letter in a bottle with a list of things that Emily has been avoiding. 1. Be Yourself 2. Reconciliation 3. Bid Farewell 4. Go Home 5. Rewind After her discovery, bizarre events keep occurring around her which leads her to believe that the bottle is actually cursed. Could it be that only way to break the curse is to follow the list of things Emily has been avoiding the most?
title: Five Missions

overview: Kittiput is a handsome, charming and a friendly millionaire who is dating the confident designer Saruda. While actively dating with her, he bumps into his childhood friend Naweeya and slowly starts to build feelings for her. Naweeya is very close to Partit, who is a rival to Kittiput and is Saruda's first love. A complicated love story will erupt, but who will they choose in the end?
title: Amazed by Love

overview: Song Ok Sook's husband walked out their family after his business went bankrupt. For the past 15 years she has raised her three daughters up to the best of her abilities. Her husband comes back into their lives and acts as if nothing's happened. To make matters worst, her eldest daughter, Ji Won, who is a doctor, tells her that she wants to marry Sung Soo, a man who she doesn't like.
title: More Charming by the Day

overview: In Rallarsving, martial arts practicer's Musse and Andreas travel the world to try and check out new martial arts.
title: Rallarsving

overview: Sunderland 'Til I Die follows English soccer club Sunderland through the 2017-18 season as they try to bounce back after relegation from the Premier League.
title: Sunderland 'Til I Die

overview: Expect bloody mayhem, cunning stunts, twisted fun, a hatful of celebrities and the world's top magicians - Barry and Stuart.
title: Dirty Tricks

overview: A man wakes up with amnesia, and has no memory of who he is or why people want him dead. Taking the name "Michael Alden", the man sets out to find out who he is and why the mysterious "Greybeards" want him dead.
title: Coronet Blue

overview: Jean Blake is drawn into the investigation of several bizarre murders whose only connection seems to be a series of articles recently published in The Courier about Ballarat's most infamous unsolved mysteries.
title: The Blake Mysteries

overview: Sitcom about a small-time dope dealer and his strange collection of acquaintances.
title: Ideal

overview: Ten physically disabled teenagers cross the Andes, one of the highest mountain ranges in the world. Over a period of four weeks and 400 km, these young people will have to fight their way from the edge of the Amazon Basin, climb to over 5000m to reach the snowline on Cotopaxi, the highest active volcano in the world, and then descend to sea level, wading through miles of swamp before reaching the Pacific Ocean.They are led by ex-SAS commando Ken Hames.
title: Beyond Boundaries

overview: Inside Jokes follows unknown stand-up comics vying to make it into the world-famous Just for Laughs comedy festival in Montreal. Will their performances launch their careers into superstardom, just like New Faces alumni Pete Holmes and Colin Jost, or will they choke under pressure? For this group of comics, who have sacrificed much in pursuit of a dream, there is no bigger moment.
title: Inside Jokes

overview: "Zirkonavty" is a new explosive comedy series on TET. Finally a team of Ukrainian cosmonauts will fly into space! A secret laboratory accidentally made an incredible discovery – our scientists have invented a super fuel in the form of a regular pill. Now, with almost unlimited energy resources at their disposal, researchers decide to organize the First Ukrainian space mission. Time is short, the crew is chosen in a hurry, and the purpose of the mission and generally forget to determine. What will happen? Follow the incredible adventures of our star scouts on TET or online. Find out how the First Ukrainian mission in space ends!
title: Зірконавти

overview: The 90's are called the wild years and a huge ordeal for everyone in Russia. It's a time when a new country with new orders and new heroes was being built on the ruins of the shattered Soviet Union. "The 1990s" is an investigative documentary. This publicistic series is about the most important phenomena in the life of the society of that time, about what every viewer of "TV Center" channel remembers: the birth of the "new Russian" class, privatization, Chechen wars, beauty contests, "Aum Shinrikyo", "Hopor Invest", criminal wars, contract killings, "shock therapy", colorful characters of newly born show business, the biggest scandals of the decade... That was a very interesting time! Each series is a personal story against the backdrop of significant political events, explaining the nature of many contemporary social problems. Each episode features interviews with participants in particular events and other witnesses of the era, unique archival footage, staged footage, and contemporary graphics.
title: Девяностые
